news.title: Asia-Pacific markets rebound with Kospi jumping 5% as Trump says Iran war could end in weeks - CNBC
news.zh: 亞太市場反彈，韓國綜合指數飆升5%，川普表示伊朗戰爭可能在數週內結束
news.impact: 地緣政治緩和推動市場情緒改善，亞股上漲

news.title: Nike Guides for Sales Declines Ahead as Turnaround Plan Hits Snags - WSJ
news.zh: 耐克指導銷售將下滑，因轉型計畫遭遇挫折
news.impact: 耐克銷售前景疲弱，消費者需求下降

news.title: OpenAI, not yet public, raises $3B from retail investors in monster $122B fund raise - TechCrunch
news.zh: 未上市的OpenAI從散戶投資者籌集30億美元，為1220億美元融資案的一部分
news.impact: OpenAI估值達1220億美元，AI產業融資創新高

news.title: Hiring in the US drops to pandemic lows as job market under Trump stagnates - Al Jazeera
news.zh: 美國招聘跌至疫情以來低點，川普執政下就業市場陷入停滯
news.impact: 美國就業市場嚴重惡化，經濟增長面臨風險

news.title: Spice maker McCormick to combine with Hellmann's maker Unilever in latest food industry shakeup - AP News
news.zh: 香料製造商美極客與蛋黃醬製造商亨氏母公司聯合利華合併，為食品業最新整合案
news.impact: 食品業併購整合加速，市場集中度提升

news.title: Oracle cuts jobs across sales, engineering, security - theregister.com
news.zh: 甲骨文在銷售、工程、安全部門裁員
news.impact: 科技大廠裁員持續，營運成本控制

news.title: Senators Question FCC Chairman Over Approval Of Nexstar-Tegna Merger - Deadline
news.zh: 參議員質詢聯邦通訊委員會主席關於批准Nexstar併購Tegna案
news.impact: 媒體併購案面臨監管審查，交易前景不確定

news.title: Oil Prices Post Biggest Monthly Surge in History - Crude Oil Prices Today | OilPrice.com
news.zh: 油價創下歷史最大單月漲幅
news.impact: 能源價格急漲，推高通膨壓力和生產成本

news.title: Mercedes to invest $4 billion in Alabama plant, marks 5 millionth vehicle built in state - Alabama Department of Commerce
news.zh: 賓士將在阿拉巴馬州投資40億美元建廠，標誌該州第500萬輛車下線
news.impact: 汽車製造商增加美國投資，就業機會擴增

news.title: Biogen to Acquire Apellis, Enhancing the Company’s Growth Portfolio in Immunology and Rare Disease, Bolstering Growth Outlook and Accelerating Expansion into Nephrology - Biogen
news.zh: 百健收購Apellis，強化免疫學和罕見疾病投資組合，加強成長前景並加速拓展腎臟病領域
news.impact: 生物製藥併購擴大產品線，強化罕見病治療能力

news.title: Lilly to acquire Centessa Pharmaceuticals to advance treatments for sleep-wake disorders - Eli Lilly
news.zh: 禮來製藥公司收購Centessa製藥公司，推進睡眠-覺醒障礙的治療方案
news.impact: 禮來製藥擴展睡眠疾病藥物管道，增強競爭力和收入潛力

news.title: US Department of Labor proposes landmark rule to democratize access to alternative investments in 401(k) plans - U.S. Department of Labor (.gov)
news.zh: 美國勞工部提出里程碑式規則，民主化401(k)計劃中另類投資的准入
news.impact: 個人退休投資選擇增加，影響資產配置和金融市場結構

news.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX could lead a wave of jumbo IPOs after reportedly making this key move
news.zh: 埃隆·馬斯克的SpaceX在做出關鍵舉措後，可能引領大型IPO浪潮
news.impact: SpaceX潛在上市引發市場熱潮，吸引大型企業跟進融資

news.title: The SpaceX IPO is great — but it won’t deliver 100x returns
news.zh: SpaceX上市不錯，但不會帶來100倍回報
news.impact: 投資者應對SpaceX IPO設定現實期望，避免過度樂觀預期
